setup.description: Create a feature branch on the DataCopilot repo (213) for eval runs. Pass the branch ID to each eval prompt.
setup.command: dxs source branch create --repo 213 --title "wizard-creator-eval-{timestamp}" --description "Temporary branch for wizard-creator skill evals"

evals.name: two-step-form-then-grid
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: build a two-step dialog eval_line_pick_wizard in Utilities. Step 1 is a small form (create eval_line_qty_form) where the user enters a target quantity; step 2 is a grid (create eval_line_pick_grid, any simple flow datasource is fine) that receives that quantity and lets the user tick rows, returning the selected row ids. The user must not be able to leave step 1 without a quantity, nor finish without at least one row selected. The caller needs to know whether the user finished or cancelled.
evals.expected_output: Validated and upserted form, grid and wizard (cti 13). The wizard's step 1 hosts the form and step 2 the grid; step 2's configParameters bind the quantity from $wizard.steps step1 outParams; both steps are gated via nextButtonDisabledCondition; on_init sets confirm false and on_finish copies the selected ids and sets confirm true.
expectations: A wizard body is created with configurationTypeId 13 and referenceName eval_line_pick_wizard (ends in _wizard)
The wizard has exactly two steps: the first with contentType "form" and configId eval_line_qty_form, the second with contentType "grid" and configId eval_line_pick_grid
Step 1 sets next to step 2's id
Step 2's configParameters bind the grid's quantity inParam to an expression reading $wizard.steps …step1… outParams (not to a wizard var or a literal)
Step 1's nextButtonDisabledCondition disables the button while the quantity outParam is undefined; step 2's disables it while the selected-ids outParam is empty or undefined
Gating expressions read step outputs via $wizard.steps (optional chaining on the step) — not via a per-step flow or a toolbar
The form and the grid each write their outParams and call events.outParamsChange.emit() so the wizard sees the values
The wizard declares a confirm boolean outParam; the init flow sets it false and the finish flow sets it true after copying the selected ids into a wizard outParam
onInitFlowConfig.flowId and onFinishFlowConfig.flowId each name a flow present in the wizard's flows[]
The wizard's title is sentence case and not equal to its referenceName; its description is non-empty and at most 100 characters
The transcript contains 'dxs configuration validate wizard' run before 'dxs configuration upsert wizard'

evals.name: configoutparameters-parity
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: create a grid eval_lot_pick_grid whose outParams are selected_lot_ids (number collection) and total_quantity (number), then a one-step wizard eval_lot_pick_wizard hosting it that returns both values to its caller. Afterwards, add a third grid outParam, selected_warehouse_id (number), and make the wizard return that too.
evals.expected_output: A wizard whose step configOutParameters mirror the grid's declared outParams exactly, re-mirrored after the grid change, with validate run on both components and a branch-level validate after the shared-callee change.
expectations: Before writing the wizard, the transcript reads the grid's declared outParams (from the body it authored or a dxs configuration get grid)
The wizard step's configOutParameters lists exactly the grid's outParams (selected_lot_ids as a number collection, total_quantity as a number) — no omissions, no extra entries
After the grid gains selected_warehouse_id, the wizard step's configOutParameters is updated to include it with type number, and the wizard is re-validated and re-upserted
The response explains that configOutParameters is a manual copy of the callee's outParams (not inherited) and that drift surfaces as 'Outdated contract. Type mismatch for output parameters'
The finish flow copies all three values from $wizard.steps …outParams into declared wizard outParams
The transcript runs 'dxs source branch validate' (or names it as the required check) after changing the shared grid's contract
The wizard's description is non-empty and at most 100 characters
The transcript contains 'dxs configuration validate wizard' run before 'dxs configuration upsert wizard'

evals.name: early-close-and-opener-branching
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: create eval_order_confirm_wizard with an order_id inParam and one grid step (create a simple eval_order_lines_grid that takes order_id). If on_init finds order_id missing it must show an error and close the wizard immediately. Then give me the flow code a hub toolbar button would use to open the wizard and run a follow-up only when the user actually finished it.
evals.expected_output: A wizard whose on_init closes early with `// @ts-ignore` above `$wizard.close()`, a confirm outParam set false in init and true in finish, and opener code calling the package-qualified Dialog opener and branching on result?.confirm.
expectations: The on_init flow calls $wizard.close() when order_id is missing, with a '// @ts-ignore' comment on the line directly above the call
The response states that IWizard has no close() in its generated typings (so the ignore is required to pass validate)
The wizard declares a confirm boolean outParam set to false in on_init and true in on_finish

The opener code calls $shell.<Package>.openeval_order_confirm_wizardDialog(...) with the snake_case referenceName preserved and the wizard's own package as the segment — and no non-Dialog full-view opener
The opener passes { order_id: … } as the first argument and branches on the resolved result's confirm (e.g. if (!result?.confirm) return;) before the follow-up
The wizard step's configParameters include an entry for the grid's order_id inParam bound to $wizard.inParams.order_id
The wizard's description is non-empty and at most 100 characters
The transcript contains 'dxs configuration validate wizard' run before 'dxs configuration upsert wizard'

evals.name: route-side-by-side-to-dashboard
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: I need a wizard where the user sees available inventory on the left and their picked inventory on the right, side by side, with a running total above both, and confirms once to return the picked lines. Build it.
evals.expected_output: The skill recognises a side-by-side composed selection, recommends and routes to dashboard-creator (dual-grid selection dashboard with a dialog contract) instead of creating a wizard, explaining that wizards have no side-by-side layout.
expectations: The response identifies that a wizard has no side-by-side or multi-panel layout (each step hosts one component) and so cannot meet the requirement
The response routes the work to dashboard-creator (a dialog dashboard with available and selected grids plus a summary section)
No wizard body (configurationTypeId 13) is upserted for this request
If any component is created, it is a dashboard (configurationTypeId 35) or its grids, and the response mentions the dashboard's confirm/is_confirmed outParam dialog contract
The transcript does not run 'dxs configuration upsert wizard'
